title: Image prompt - Engineer
promptText:
Generate a realistic photograph of an electrical transmission engineer inspecting outdoor switchyard equipment during daytime.

Subject: adult engineer in PPE (helmet, high-visibility vest, safety boots), holding a clipboard or tablet, standing at a respectful safe distance from equipment.

Setting: Indian state utility switchyard; clean, orderly, professional atmosphere.

Style: editorial documentary, natural lighting, 35mm look, muted colours.

Strict exclusions:
- No celebrity or politician likenesses
- No readable name badges, IDs, or Aadhaar-like cards
- No brand logos on equipment
- No dramatised sparks, explosions, or accidents
- No text in the image

Purpose: illustration for internal training on field inspection discipline — not a stock "hero" poster.
